name: vampi
description: VAmPI (github.com/erev0s/VAmPI) in vulnerable mode. Verified against a live instance on 2026-09-01. Its clean, in-scope object-level BOLA is GET /books/v1/{book_title}: with a valid token, any user receives any book's secret_content regardless of owner. metewise catches it in both directions with the secret as evidence. See results/vampi.md for numbers and scope notes.

out_of_scope.note: Real VAmPI bugs that metewise v1 does not (and does not claim to) detect, with why:

items.why: no auth at all -> anon receives it too, so metewise's anon-control correctly classifies it as public, not cross-user BOLA. It is a missing-authentication bug, a different class.
write-only sub-resource with no readable state at the same URL; the effect (changed password) is not observable via GET, so the effect-based write oracle cannot confirm it.
the seeded usernames (name1/name2) are under 6 chars, below metewise's identifier-length floor, so /users/v1/{username} is never templated.
